:::{#exm-product-of-sums}
#### Checking FOIL

With $a = 1$, $b = 2$, $c = 3$ and $d = 4$,

$$
\begin{aligned}
(1 + 2)(3 + 4) &= 3 \cdot 7 \\
&= 21,
\end{aligned}
$$

and

$$
\begin{aligned}
1 \cdot 3 + 1 \cdot 4 + 2 \cdot 3 + 2 \cdot 4 &= 3 + 4 + 6 + 8 \\
&= 21.
\end{aligned}
$$

Setting $c = a$ and $d = b$ gives $(a + b)^2 = a^2 + ab + ba + b^2$,
which is the [square of a sum](#thm-square-of-a-sum) once $ab$ and $ba$ are combined.

:::
